text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, world...!
What a refreshing morning this is!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Benevolent, warm sunlight filtering through the trees, accompanied by the lovely chirping of little birds—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It feels as though the entire world is celebrating my awakening!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"This must all be thanks to
that wonderful Umamusume who appeared in my dream..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, me!
Thanks to you, I woke up feeling absolutely great today!

text_block_list.name: Illusory Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No need for thanks, my boy...
I'll appear at your bedside in your dreams as many times as you like!
